summary.intent: Complete Phase 25 (desktop-enhancements) of the cipher-box-worker2 project, implementing TEE file enrollment, auto-updater integration, and CI desktop build workflows for the Tauri desktop app.
summary.outcome: All 3 plans (25-01, 25-02, 25-03) completed successfully with 9/9 verification checks passing. Phase 25 marked complete in ROADMAP, STATE.md advanced, and artifacts committed.

repo: Both Unix and Windows publish_file_metadata paths need to be updated in parallel when adding new file enrollment behavior.
The project uses a structured planning system under .planning/ with ROADMAP.md, config.json, phase directories, and VERIFICATION.md files per phase.
Regression gate for the fuse crate uses: cargo check -p cipherbox-fuse --features fuse — warnings from vendored fuser crate are expected and non-blocking.
tauri.conf.json holds the Ed25519 public key for updater signature verification; the private key is stored as a GitHub Actions secret.

code.finding: Verification artifacts are written per-phase and committed alongside ROADMAP.md and config.json updates at phase completion.

workflow: Phase completion follows a fixed sequence: verify must-haves (9/9 pattern), update ROADMAP.md, advance STATE.md, then commit all planning artifacts together.
A verifier subagent is spawned after inline regression checks pass, separating regression gating from goal-achievement verification.
Cross-platform Tauri builds use a 4-platform matrix (macOS ARM, macOS Intel, Linux, Windows) triggered by Release Please publish events.
Updater-compatible artifacts require both .sig sidecar files and a latest.json manifest.

open_items: TEE IPNS republishing (3-hour interval) depends on the TEE consuming the wrapped keys enrolled during publish_file_metadata — integration with the TEE service itself was not part of this phase.
Ed25519 keypair and GitHub secrets configuration was described as complete but relies on manual secret setup outside the codebase.
